headline: 2003 order freezes US-held property of people found to be undermining democratic processes or institutions in Zimbabwe.
what_it_does: This executive order blocks, or freezes, property and interests in property belonging to certain people tied to undermining democratic processes or institutions in Zimbabwe. Blocked property generally cannot be moved, sold, or used while it is under US control. Only the title was provided, so details such as who is named and how people are added are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: People and groups found to be undermining democracy in Zimbabwe
who_it_affects.how: Their property and interests in property that fall under US control are frozen.
They would generally be barred from dealing in property of the people covered by the order.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed March 6, 2003; the exact effective date is not stated in the material provided.
